units.source_text: 不久，他像来到了村落的尽头，道路和沙丘的棱线重叠，视线开阔，左手边望得见大海。

en.t: Before long, he seemed to have reached the end of the village; the road overlapped with the ridge of the dunes, the view opened out, and he could see the sea on his left.

units.source_text: 风里夹杂着潮水的咸味，耳朵、鼻翼像抽响铁陀螺似的嗡嗡呻吟起来。

en.t: The wind was mixed with the salty smell of the tide, and his ears and nostrils began to buzz and moan like a ringing iron top.

units.source_text: 扎在颈子上的手巾飘打在脸颊上，这里到底没有涌起薄雾的力量。

en.t: The towel tied around his neck fluttered and slapped against his cheeks; after all, this place did not have the strength to raise even a thin mist.

units.source_text: 海上像镀了一层朦胧的耐酸铝，涌来一阵小波浪，像煮沸牛奶上结起的那层皱皮。

en.t: The sea looked as though it had been coated with a hazy layer of acid-resistant aluminum, and a small wave came rolling in like the wrinkled skin that forms on boiled milk.

units.source_text: 食用青蛙卵似的云彩像被压碎了，太阳不愿沉溺，死缠硬磨地撒娇。

en.t: Clouds like edible frog eggs seemed to have been crushed, while the sun, unwilling to sink, clung on stubbornly and coquettishly scattered its light.

units.source_text: 水平线上，不知距离，不知大小的黑黑船影，聚成一点，停了下来。

en.t: On the horizon, dark silhouettes of boats, whose distance and size were impossible to tell, gathered into a single point and came to a stop.
